messages:
Maya: Quick syncACME pushed two asks that stress our Q2 plan: per-tenant routing parity and a lightweight fallback for low-tier tenants. They need dates. Can we triage?
Liam: Parity is doable but touches routing, Console UI, RBAC. MVP if we cut scope ~6w.
Arjun: Schema assumes org-wide rules. Per-tenant needs migration + config model. Rough: 3w infra, 2w runtime, 1w QA.
Priya: Ask ACME whether exact parity is required. Maybe a 'compatibility mode' shim mapping tenant rules to org rules would satisfy them. :thinking_face: 
Zoe: Shim buys time but creates debt. Must include sunset plan in docs.
Kevin (sales): ACME will stall procurement without per-tenant controls. They can give +2w if we commit to a clear GA roadmap.
Maya: Proposal: gated shim-MVP that meets gating criteria, then full parity later. Need launch criteria consensus.
Arjun: If shim-MVP, lock safe defaults and add a feature flag for rollback.
Priya: Draft launch criteria: 1) Shim enabled with documented limitations; 2) UI shows "tenant routing" limited (create/edit only); 3) E2E tests + canary to Dedicated; 4) Rollback flag + migration dry-run; 5) Sales doc with limitations.
Maya: Add SLO: routing latency bump <=20% and must pass ACME sample traffic test.
Liam: I'll scope minimal Console flow (list/create/edit) and wire the flag. Need Arjun and EngSRE for rollout.
Arjun: Rollout plan: 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100% with artifact rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2187657200 pending approvals.
Zoe: Alternative: full parity now -> 10-12w but cleaner arch. Include tradeoff doc.
Kevin (sales): I need a customer-facing ETA by EOD to stall procurement smartly.
Maya: Actions: Liam deliver console PR + estimate by EOD; Arjun deliver migration/rollout plan + risks in 2d; Zoe draft debt/sunset language tomorrow; Priya update launch checklist with SLOs + ACME test plan by tomorrow noon; Kevin hold cadence with ACME and communicate preferred date next week.
Maya: If no objections, I'll put shim-MVP on live roadmap and mark full parity as follow-up epic. :thumbsup: 
Liam: No objections.
Arjun: Agree, track tech debt item.
Priya: Product OK; external name "compatibility-mode v1".
Kevin (sales): I'll push ACME to accept compatibility-mode timeline.
Zoe: Schedule follow-up to revisit arch decision after canary.
Maya: I'll update roadmap entry and post a short brief to #exec-sync once rollout plan is ready.
